With exclusions, you can restrict the scanning of specific hosts based on a selected schedule. Use
the API to perform standard CRUD operations on exclusion objects, and also import exclusions.
string
The name of the uploaded file. If the file with the same name already
exists, Tenable Vulnerability Management appends an underscore with a
number, for example ssh_private_key_1.txt. Use this attribute value when
referencing the file for subsequent requests.
— 400
Returned if your request is malformed (for example, the request is missing a required query parameter
or an invalid file is provided).
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 500 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management cannot upload the file.
